summary: Lando Norris aims to extend his championship lead from pole position at Zandvoort, but Mercedes' George Russell—who dominated the sprint race—poses an immediate threat to the world champion's dominance. Russell's sprint victory and prior pole position demonstrate Mercedes' genuine pace advantage in race trim, creating a genuine three-way battle with Ferrari's Charles Leclerc for Sunday's podium. A Norris victory strengthens his title grip heading toward the season's final stretch, while a Russell or Leclerc triumph would signal a fundamental shift in the pecking order before the playoffs begin.
